content.body:
Yes, sorry -- basically, if you _could_ run user code by resolving a promise, the promise is latched, but then the actual resolution (where the user code is run) is deferred to another microtask. 

The end goal here is to kill the litany of security bugs caused by creating `then` on `Object.prototype`
